h1: WordPress theme edits that keep your site safe
overview: Send us a list of what looks wrong or what you want changed in your current theme. We make the edits in a child theme so your updates are never overwritten, and we test the result on desktop and phone before it goes live. That can mean layout fixes, new page templates, header or footer changes, or tidying styles. We work on a staging copy first and apply it to your live site once you approve.

faq: Will edits disappear when the theme updates?
Not if we use a child theme, which is what we do. Your changes sit in their own folder, so the parent theme can update without wiping your work.
Which themes do you work with?
Most popular themes and page builders, including block themes, Astra, Kadence, GeneratePress, Divi and Elementor. If your theme is unusual, send a link and we confirm before quoting.
Do you edit my live site directly?
We prefer a staging copy so visitors never see half-finished work. If your host has no staging, we make a backup first and keep any live changes small.
What if I do not know what is wrong?
Send screenshots, page links and a few words on what looks off. We turn that into a clear fix list for you to approve before we start.
